description: English-only technical probe that adds the repository's STE-oriented prose constraints in docs/i18n/ste100.md to the technical rules. English text only, and only when the user asks for it. This is not ASD-STE100 certification and does not claim full compliance.

rules.instruction: Use a maximum of 20 words in an instruction sentence and 25 words in a description sentence.
rules.rationale: The limits come from docs/i18n/ste100.md. A shorter sentence gives a reader one item to act on.

rules.instruction: Use a maximum of six sentences in a paragraph, and give each paragraph one topic.
rules.rationale: The limit comes from docs/i18n/ste100.md. One topic per paragraph makes the structure visible.

rules.instruction: Use the active voice, and give an instruction with a command verb.
rules.rationale: The active voice names the actor. A reader then knows who performs the step.

rules.instruction: Put the condition before the instruction.
rules.rationale: A reader who meets the condition first knows whether the step applies before reading it.

rules.instruction: Use one name for one item, and use the approved word from docs/i18n/ste100.md.
rules.rationale: A synonym for one item reads as a second item. The approved word keeps one meaning.
One spelling convention avoids a mixed result in one document.

rules.instruction: Keep a technical noun or technical verb where the software meaning needs it, and do not reclassify a general word as a technical term.
rules.rationale: The technical vocabulary table in docs/i18n/ste100.md lists the permitted software meanings. An invented technical sense misleads a reader.

rules.instruction: Keep literal tool names, paths, settings, status labels, code, and user-interface text unchanged.
rules.rationale: A changed literal no longer agrees with the runtime, and the reader cannot follow the step.

rules.instruction: Do not call the result ASD-STE100 compliant or certified.
rules.rationale: These are selected constraints, not a dictionary check or a certification. A compliance claim would be false.

rules.instruction: Apply this profile only to English text and only when the user asks for it.
rules.rationale: The 20-word and 25-word limits would harm prose that reads well in longer sentences. The default technical profile does not impose them.
